review_blockers.summary: Creeping Manifold is reviewed as a healer obligation with sustained pressure semantics: source-backed encounter data describes continuous unavoidable high flame damage to several targets, and independent healer/raid sources consistently describe it as a heal-check. Rotation Builder execution is still blocked because canonical runtime timing, exact modeled demand width, and authoritative hardmode target scope are not yet established.
review_blockers.needed_evidence: Validate Creeping Manifold from representative runtime/log evidence to establish cast-to-first-hit timing, active duration, tick cadence, and hardmode target scope. Existing research candidates are approximately 1.3-second damage frequency and 3 hardmode targets; keep both as corroboration only until runtime evidence confirms them. Demand kind=healing and pattern=sustained are reviewed; do not infer a clock window from the Phase 2 70% transition.
review_blockers.source_context: data/eso_info/bosses/xalvakka.json Creeping Manifold; data/encounter_evidence/rockgrove_boss3.json creeping_manifold; Facehead McGee Rockgrove Healer Guide chapter 'Heal-Check (Manifold)'; ESOAZ Rockgrove HM guide (3-target research candidate); ESO official forum PTS Update 34 healer feedback by SeaUnicorn (1.3s-frequency research candidate)

review_blockers.summary: Xalvakka transitions at 70% and 40% are reviewed, rising lava kills players left behind, and healer-specific guidance separately calls out healing the stairs; the transition's healer-demand timing and target scope are not yet reviewed as executable Rotation Builder policy.
review_blockers.needed_evidence: Review the damage actually taken during each stair transition, whether the healer obligation begins before or after the health threshold, its duration, and target scope. The old audit-only 3-second preparation lead must not be promoted automatically.
review_blockers.source_context: data/encounter_evidence/rockgrove_boss3.json retreat_thresholds, retreat_lava_catches_left_behind_players, phase_2, phase_3; Facehead McGee Rockgrove Healer Guide chapter 'Healing Stairs'

review_blockers.summary: During Xalvakka's split the floor is reviewed to deal continuous flame damage to the group, and independent guides explicitly instruct healers to keep healing through the split; however the split event has no reviewed clock/health trigger suitable for direct Rotation Builder scheduling yet.
review_blockers.needed_evidence: Review a canonical trigger or runtime-detection rule for split start/end and confirm target scope. Healing/sustained pressure is source-supported, but no fixed lead, fixed duration, or 12-target executable policy should be invented from that description alone.
review_blockers.source_context: data/encounter_evidence/rockgrove_boss3.json split_exists and phase_2_floor_fire_during_split; AlcastHQ Rockgrove guide Xalvakka Phase 2; Xynode Rockgrove guide 'Which one is real?'; Facehead McGee Rockgrove Healer Guide chapter 'Healing Triple Split Damage'
